Credits pay for two things: Agenta's included models, and runtime, the time your agents run. Each plan includes credits. The Plans and credits page lists what each thing costs.
How many credits does each plan include?

Every plan gets 75 free credits a day, on up to 10 days a month. Starter adds 2,900 credits a month, and Business adds 32,000 credits a month. New organizations also get 500 bonus credits when they sign up.
How many credits does a task use?
Do I pay when I use my own API key or my ChatGPT subscription?
The model costs no credits. Runtime still uses credits, because your agent still runs on Agenta. Every plan can use your own API key or ChatGPT subscription.
No. Daily credits expire at the end of the day (midnight UTC), and monthly credits expire at the end of the billing period.
What happens when I run out of credits?
Yes. Credits belong to the organization, and everyone in it draws from the same balance. There is no per-seat price.
Yes, on Starter and Business. 1,000 credits cost $10, 2,500 credits cost $25, and 10,000 credits cost $100.
How many tasks can run at once?

Hobby runs 2 concurrent tasks, Starter runs 20, and Business runs 50. A task is one agent turn: from your message until the agent finishes answering. The Plans and credits page says how long a task can run on each plan.
Are users, projects, agents, and automations really unlimited?
Will my agent act without my approval?
Agenta's included models are Gemini 3.7 Flash, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Gemini 4 Argon, Gemini 4 Carbon, and Gemini 4 Neon. They use credits, so you need no API key to start.
Which model providers can I use?
Can I switch plans or cancel at any time?
Yes. Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel from Settings, then Usage & Billing.
Your organization keeps its data and moves to Hobby at the end of the billing period. Members beyond the Hobby limit of 2 are removed.
How do I get an invoice?
Open Settings, then Usage & Billing, then Open billing portal. The billing portal lists your invoices and payment methods.
Do you use my data to train AI models?
No. Agenta does not use your prompts or data to train AI models.
Where can I see my credits?
Open Settings, then Credits to see your balance and what used your credits. Open Settings, then Usage & Billing to see your plan.
